title: Hydrogen storage in Nickel dispersed boron doped reduced graphene oxide
material_description: B-rGO | boron doped reduced graphene oxide: rGO (modified-Hummers GO thermally reduced at 400 C, 2 h) sonicated in DI water with boric acid (1:16), stirred 4 h at 35 C, quenched in liquid nitrogen, freeze dried under vacuum 36 h, calcined at 800 C for 3 h in Ar
functional_groups: O-H, C-H, B-O, C-B, O-B-O (FTIR)
source_location: HYC-0040_main p. 7, Fig. 8(i) (T = 77 K), series B-rGO (blue circles), marker 1 of 30 (by pressure)

Dopant concentration of B-rGO not printed in the main text. Basis not named; volumetric (Sieverts) value, basis_inferred by instrumental default. (2): wt.%H = m_hydrogen_gas/(m_sample + m_hydrogen_gas) x 100. Degassed at 100 C (based on TGA) for 12 h before PCI; 'Nearly 200 mg' sample in a 2 cc chamber; H2 99.99%. functional_groups: O-H and C=O (reduced), aromatic C-C/C=C, C-H (FTIR)
source_location: HYC-0040_main p. 7, Fig. 8(i) (T = 77 K), series rGO (green squares), marker 3 of 33 (by pressure)
notes: archive: Fig8i_77K_rGO.json; digitized pressure 2.5985 atm (axis in atm) converted to bar x 1.01325. BET area 897 m2/g from text p. 6 (also Supplementary Table S2, not among input pages); N2 at 77 K, Autosorb iQ (Quantachrome); P/P0 between 0 and 1 is stated for the N2 adsorption/desorption study, not as the BET fit range. Interlayer spacing 0.35 nm from XRD (002) at 25.3 deg (p. 3). Basis not named; volumetric (Sieverts) value, basis_inferred by instrumental default. Instrument: Gas Reaction Controller (GRC), Advanced Materials Corporation, USA (manufacturer and product named); Honeywell TJE transducers. wt% convention W2 stated by Eq. (2): wt.%H = m_hydrogen_gas/(m_sample + m_hydrogen_gas) x 100. Degassed at 100 C (based on TGA) for 12 h before PCI; 'Nearly 200 mg' sample in a 2 cc chamber; H2 99.99%. Chamber 'checked for any leaks and calibrated using standard samples like LaNi5 and basolite (C-300) at 298 K and 77 K'; free-volume determination not described, so calibration_described = false. PCI (absorption) branch only.
